items.html:
(to the question) Elokim with a filling of Hehin
Since in the phase of nursing there is no state of HB but only face-to-back, in which Bina has not yet turned her Achoraim away from Hochma, as is known, therefore the brain of Bina, which is Elokim with a filling of Hehin, is discerned like this: Alef, Lamed, Heh, Yod, Mem. For the filling of Hehin indicates the phase of Achoraim. (Part 1, Page 234, Item 276).
